description: This file defines a static class 'Identifier' with methods to check if a string is a C# keyword and to sanitize strings into valid C# identifiers, including handling leading digits and invalid characters.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: A static utility class for handling C# identifiers, including keyword checking and sanitization.

methods.name: IsCSharpKeyword
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a reserved C# keyword.

methods.name: SanitizeIdentifierName
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be a valid C# identifier by prefixing leading digits with '_' and removing invalid characters.
